observations.name: direct-remote-root-contributes-to-event-work
observations.observed: __unwire returned __validate(result, type, depth) for the root value
observations.expected: the fully materialized root also passes through __check
observations.impact: A sequence of individually bounded direct remote assignments did not contribute those returned roots to the event-wide 64 MiB managed-value work budget.

reproduction_boundary: The failure is established from the exact pre-fix generated-runtime source. No hostile remote service was used to allocate the full 64 MiB in Chrome.
